name: write_session_files
description: Upload files to a session's filesystem as a base64-encoded gzipped tarball (.tar.gz) in requestBody. The contents are extracted into the sandbox home directory, or into the directory given in xCwd, and may overwrite existing files at the same paths.

requestBody.description: A base64-encoded gzipped tarball to extract. Provide this binary value as a base64 string.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session to write files to.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

xCwd.description: The target directory where the tarball contents will be extracted. If not specified, files are extracted to the sandbox home directory.
